§4§lCrafting Dead Modpack - Version 1.2.0§r
§a§lMajor Base System Update§r
§rA completely new Base System has arrived! Build, manage and defend your own base with the new Blueprint building system.
- Added a completely new Base System - Added a new Blueprint building system for constructing bases - Added Blueprints for walls, platforms, slabs, stairs, doors, door walls, sleeping bags, campfires, furnaces, water pumps, signs and other base structures - Added Wood, Stone, Metal and Concrete building tiers - Added a new Base Center used to manage and control your base - Added Base member management - Added different Base member roles and permissions - Added Base ownership transfer - Added Base crafting and recipe management - Added a search bar to the Base crafting menu - Added Base Shields - Added Base repairing - Added Base raiding and explosive damage - Added Base destruction and loot handling - Added Loot Bags for resources dropped from destroyed bases - Added Wooden Base Chests - Added Base Furnaces - Added Water Pumps
§6§lResources & Production§r
- Added Metal Ore generation - Added Metal Ore regeneration - Added Sulfur Ore generation - Added Sulfur Ore regeneration - Added Metal Ingot processing through Base Furnaces - Improved Base Furnace processing - Improved Water Pump processing - Improved world resource generation - Improved resource regeneration
§e§lTrader System§r
- Added a completely new Trader system - Added configurable Trader offers and stock - Improved Trader handling - Adjusted several Trader offers and usage limits
§c§lExplosives & Grenades§r
- Added the ability to attach C4 to Flies - Added visible C4 models to Flies carrying explosives - Added the ability to shoot certain explosives such as C4 - Improved grenade throwing behavior - Improved grenade bouncing and collision behavior - Improved grenade models and rotations while moving - Improved C4 behavior - Fixed several grenade collision issues - Fixed several grenade rendering issues - Fixed C4 positioning and rendering issues
§b§lQuality of Life§r
- Added an option to automatically translate chat messages into your selected language (enabled by default) - Added support for localized Holograms - Added configurable Binocular scope sensitivity - Improved Blueprint previews to clearly show valid and invalid placement positions - Improved Blueprint snapping and placement behavior - Improved Base member management - Improved Base ownership and permission handling - Improved language support - Improved translation fallback behavior - Fixed Binoculars interacting with chests, levers and other usable blocks
§d§lCombat & Killfeed Improvements§r
- Improved Killfeed detection - Improved Killfeed support for explosives and environmental deaths - Fixed incorrect Killfeed attribution for some grenade kills - Improved weapon inspect animations - Fixed several weapon inspect animation issues - Fixed inspect animations continuing when switching weapons - Fixed inspect animations conflicting with reloading - Fixed inspect animations conflicting with magazine removal - Fixed inspect animations conflicting with sprinting - Fixed inspect animations conflicting with aiming
§7§lOther Improvements§r
- Improved Base loading and synchronization - Improved Base destruction behavior - Improved Base Center loot handling - Increased Wooden Base Chest durability - Improved general UI synchronization - Improved client and server stability - Fixed several potential client and server crashes - Fixed potential crashes related to the Immerse menu and server list
§aThank you for playing Crafting Dead!§r
§4§lChernarus Open Beta Test is Live!§r
§aThe wait is over! Chernarus is now available for open beta testing
§rJoin the fight for survival in this massive open-world experience. Explore, loot, and battle your way through the infected wasteland§r
New expansive Chernarus map Safe zones Black Market (Coming Soon) Loot placement still being adjusted Hero/Bandit reputation system in development Modpack is in **BETA**, expect frequent updates and changes
§eWe need your feedback!§r Join our Discord and share your thoughts, report bugs, and help shape the future of Chernarus!
§a§lDead Island is now open for beta!§r
§rYou can find more information about the beta in the #dead-island channel in our Discord server.
§oWe are looking for builders to continue expanding and updating our maps so send in your applications on Discord!
§4§lVersion 1.7.5§r
- Updated Forge to 36.2.23 - Updated Mods (SecurityCraft, Mekanism, Mobs and many more) - Patched Several Bugs - Added New Mods (Lamps and Furniture) - You can also see the changelog on the website - Updated Terms and Conditions
§4§lVersion 1.7.4§r
- Updated Forge to 36.2.20 to patch Log4Shell exploit.
§4§lVersion 1.7.4§r
- Removed Better Animals Plus in favour of Alex's Mobs. - Removed Macaw's Furniture Mod due to bug.
§4§lVersion 1.7.3§r
- Removed Sodium due to crashing - Updated mods
§4§lVersion 1.7.2§r
- Added the rest of Pam's HarvestCraft *finally* - Added Vanilla Builders Extension - Added Sodium for improved performance
Legacy maps are in the process of being ported - expect to see Dead Island and Atlanta appearing in the near future.
The new gun models are estimated to be finished by the end of October - this means they can be fully implemented by around mid January to Febuary.
- §6Sm0keySa1m0n

§4§lVersion 1.5.0§r
In this update we've added MrCrayfish's Vehicle Mod and updated the core Crafting Dead mods.
Crafting Dead Core/Survival/Immerse Changelog:
- Fixed health/armor int rounding on HUD - Fix gun firing bug - Remove debug sysout - Added Russian translation - Tweaked zombie spawn rate - Changed supply drop radio recipes - Prevent fire damage + spread - Fix threading bugs/improve thread safety
- §6Sm0keySa1m0n
§4§lVersion 1.4.0§r
This update fixes a few bugs that have been occuring:
- Fire no longer crashes the game - Player stats no longer disappear when travelling between dimensions - Smelting iron ore has been fixed - Fixed fire rate bug - Fixed vest GUI
We're still waiting on the new models to be finished. In the mean time, I have been working on a new base system for the mod, more information on this will be released further on in development.
- §6Sm0keySa1m0n
§4§lVersion 1.2.0§r
This update features the first full release of Crafting Dead Immerse. Immerse adds a fancy new menu which you're looking at right now, but most excitingly it brings the much anticipated game mode system. We are currently hosting a single Team Deathmatch server which you can check out by pressing the play button to your left but there's more on its way in future updates.
Also, at the time of writing this, new gun models are in development which will replace all existing models in the game. This will bring a much needed refresh to the original 1.6.4 models (which you may notice are a bit glitchy in 1.16 due to the conversion to the new model format).
Our builders are still hard at work finishing off the maps for the official (survival) servers. In the mean time hop on to our alpha server, play some TDM, perhaps start a server of your own or play solo in a singleplayer world.
- §6Sm0keySa1m0n
